The Chinese characters for Sharon

As a transliteration, Sharon is usually written 莎伦 (Shā lún). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

The name Sharon has Hebrew roots and means “the plain of Sharon”.

About the name Sharon

A place name from the fertile plain of Sharon in Israel.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Sharon carries the meaning “the plain of Sharon” and looks striking in brush strokes.
